newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real closes flat in calm post-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real closes flat in calm post-holiday trade.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0391 against the dollar in calm post-holiday trade on strong dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
In the afternoon the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0390 reais per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Thursday surplus of $230 million.
Dealers said they expect another calm trade session on Friday, anticipating no new change in the real-dollar mini-band before next week.
The current mini-band was fixed by the Central Bank on Tuesday between 1.0390 and 1.0440 reais per dollar.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0447 to the dollar, up 0.03 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.120 per greenback.
